text:
User asks: 根据ACMG规则评估FGFR3;NM_000142.5:c.1075+95C>G杂合变异的致病性。

Assistant calls mcp__tooluniverse__find_tools, then mcp__tooluniverse__execute_tool with GeneBe_classify_variant, SpliceAI_predict_splice, EnsemblVEP_annotate_hgvs, and MyVariant_get_pathogenicity_scores. GeneBe reports Likely_pathogenic with score 9 and criteria PS3, PM2, PP3_Moderate, PP5. SpliceAI reports high splice impact.

FINAL CLASSIFICATION: Likely Pathogenic (ACMG Class 4)
Applied evidence: PM2, PM4, PP3_Moderate, PP1, PP4, PP5.

No acmg_assessment_bundle was emitted and no validator summary was run.
